mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", repeat_scope_type_id AS "repeatScopeTypeId", repeat_count AS "repeatCount", repeat_tag AS "repeatTag", trigger_state_key AS "triggerStateKey", threshold AS "threshold", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.repeat_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND step_id = #{stepId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.repeat_effect_details (game_id, step_id, repeat_scope_type_id, repeat_count, repeat_tag, trigger_state_key, threshold, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{stepId}, #{repeatScopeTypeId}, #{repeatCount}, #{repeatTag}, #{triggerStateKey}, #{threshold}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id) DO UPDATE SET repeat_scope_type_id = EXCLUDED.repeat_scope_type_id, repeat_count = EXCLUDED.repeat_count, repeat_tag = EXCLUDED.repeat_tag, trigger_state_key = EXCLUDED.trigger_state_key, threshold = EXCLUDED.threshold, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", repeat_scope_type_id AS "repeatScopeTypeId", repeat_count AS "repeatCount", repeat_tag AS "repeatTag", trigger_state_key AS "triggerStateKey", threshold AS "threshold", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.repeat_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, step_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.repeat_effect_details_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, step_id, repeat_scope_type_id, repeat_count, repeat_tag, trigger_state_key, threshold ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, step_id, repeat_scope_type_id, repeat_count, repeat_tag, trigger_state_key, threshold FROM public.repeat_effect_details WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, repeat_scope_type_id = EXCLUDED.repeat_scope_type_id, repeat_count = EXCLUDED.repeat_count, repeat_tag = EXCLUDED.repeat_tag, trigger_state_key = EXCLUDED.trigger_state_key, threshold = EXCLUDED.threshold
